name: registry validates and retrieves each supported data-structure kind
input: one text count labels and properties resource
test:
registry = TypedResourceRegistry()
registry.register(Resource('title', 'text', 'hello'))
registry.register(Resource('retries', 'count', 3))
registry.register(Resource('tags', 'labels', ('ml', 'systems')))
registry.register(Resource('config', 'properties', {'enabled': True, 'rate': 0.25}))
assert registry.get('title').payload == 'hello'
assert registry.get('retries', 'count').payload == 3
assert registry.get('tags').payload == ['ml', 'systems']
assert registry.get('config').payload == {'enabled': True, 'rate': 0.25}
assert registry.names() == ['config', 'retries', 'tags', 'title']
assert registry.names('labels') == ['tags']

name: inputs and returned resources cannot mutate stored nested payloads
input: one labels input and one properties input mutated after registration
test:
registry = TypedResourceRegistry()
labels = ['one', 'two']
properties = {'items': 2}
registry.register(Resource('labels', 'labels', labels))
registry.register(Resource('props', 'properties', properties))
labels.append('tampered')
properties['items'] = 99
view = registry.get('labels')
view.payload.append('changed')
property_view = registry.get('props')
property_view.payload['items'] = 0
assert registry.get('labels').payload == ['one', 'two']
assert registry.get('props').payload == {'items': 2}

name: kind mismatches removal and missing names follow registry behavior
input: a text resource read through a wrong expected kind then removed
test:
registry = TypedResourceRegistry()
registry.register(Resource('name', 'text', 'ada'))
try:
    registry.get('name', 'count')
    raise AssertionError('expected TypeError')
except TypeError:
    pass
assert registry.remove('name') is True
assert registry.remove('name') is False
try:
    registry.get('name')
    raise AssertionError('expected KeyError')
except KeyError:
    pass
